bullets.script:
control-agent-server doctor
control-agent-server llm preset deepseek --no-validate
CID=$(control-agent-server conversation start --no-autotitle --tools none --print-id)
QA_UNKNOWN=00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000f6

control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/search" --expect 200 \
  --check items len-eq 0 --check next_page_id missing
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events" \
  --json '{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"QA_F06_FIRST hello"}],"run":false}' \
  --expect 200 --check success eq true --save F06.send-no-run/post
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/search" --expect 200 \
  --check items len-eq 3 --check items.0.kind eq SystemPromptEvent --check items.0.source eq agent \
  --check items.1.kind eq MessageEvent --check items.1.source eq user \
  --check items.1.llm_message.content.0.text eq 'QA_F06_FIRST hello' \
  --check items.2.kind eq ConversationStateUpdateEvent --check items.2.key eq last_user_message_id \
  --save F06.send-no-run/search
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID" --check execution_status eq idle
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events" \
  --json '{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"QA_F06_SECOND again"}]}' --expect 200
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/count" --check . eq 5

E2=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/search" --query body=QA_F06_SECOND --field items.0.id)
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/$E2" --expect 200 --check id eq "$E2" \
  --check kind eq MessageEvent --check source eq user --check llm_message.content.0.text eq 'QA_F06_SECOND again' \
  --save F06.get-one/get
control-agent-server state cat "server/workspace/conversations/${CID//-/}/events/event-00003-$E2.json" \
  --check id eq "$E2" --check kind eq MessageEvent

bullets.bullet: Run a turn and watch it live (`F06.send-run`, `F06.ws-live`).
bullets.script:
LIVE=$(control-agent-server conversation start --no-autotitle --tools file_editor --print-id)
control-agent-server ws start "/sockets/events/$LIVE" --name f06-live
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$LIVE/events" \
  --json '{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Create qa.txt containing exactly: QA_F06_LIVE"}],"run":true}' \
  --expect 200 --check success eq true --save F06.send-run/post
control-agent-server conversation wait "$LIVE" --until finished --timeout 240
control-agent-server ws stop f06-live --wait 30 \
  --kinds ConversationStateUpdateEvent --contains '"key": "full_state"' --expect-min 2 --save F06.ws-live/frames
control-agent-server ws read f06-live --kinds ActionEvent --expect-min 1
LIVE_IDS=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$LIVE/events/search" --field items | jq -c '[.[].id]')
control-agent-server ws read f06-live --kinds MessageEvent --contains QA_F06_LIVE
control-agent-server ws read f06-live --kinds ConversationStateUpdateEvent --contains '"value": "running"'
control-agent-server ws read f06-live --kinds ObservationEvent --contains '"tool_name": "file_editor"'
control-agent-server ws read f06-live --kinds ConversationStateUpdateEvent --contains '"value": "finished"'
LIVE_FRAMES=$(control-agent-server ws read f06-live --save F06.ws-live/all-frames | jq -r .saved)
jq -e --argjson ids "$LIVE_IDS" '[.frames[] | select(.direction == "received") | .frame | select(.key != "full_state") | .id] | (length > 0) and (. - $ids == [])' "$LIVE_FRAMES"
control-agent-server conversation events "$LIVE" --kinds ObservationEvent --contains file_editor --save F06.send-run/observations
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$LIVE/events/count" \
  --query kind=openhands.sdk.event.llm_convertible.action.ActionEvent --check . ge 1
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$LIVE/events/count" \
  --query kind=openhands.sdk.event.llm_convertible.observation.ObservationEvent --check . ge 1
control-agent-server conversation events "$LIVE" --key stats --expect-min 1
LIVE_WS=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$LIVE" --field workspace.working_dir)
grep -q QA_F06_LIVE "$LIVE_WS/qa.txt"

control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/count" --query kind=openhands.sdk.event.llm_convertible.message.MessageEvent --check . eq 2 --save F06.search-kind-short-count/fqn-control
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/count" --query kind=MessageEvent --check . eq 2 --save F06.search-kind-short-count/short-count  # bug

control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events" --json "[\"$E2\"]" --expect 200 --check . len-eq 1 --check 0.id eq "$E2" --save F06.unknown-event-batch/known-control
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events" --json "[\"$E2\",\"qa-missing-event\"]" --expect 200 --check . len-eq 2 --check 0.id eq "$E2" --check 1 missing --save F06.unknown-event-batch/mixed  # bug

EMPTY_ROLE=$(control-agent-server conversation start --no-autotitle --tools none --print-id)
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$EMPTY_ROLE/events/count" --check . eq 0 --save F06.send-non-user-role-empty/before
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$EMPTY_ROLE/events" --json '{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"QA_F06_ASSISTANT_EMPTY"}]}' --expect 4xx --save F06.send-non-user-role-empty/post  # bug

MUT_ROLE=$(control-agent-server conversation start --no-autotitle --tools none --print-id)
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$MUT_ROLE/events/count" --check . eq 0 --save F06.send-non-user-role-empty-mutation/before
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$MUT_ROLE/events" --json '{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"QA_F06_ASSISTANT_EMPTY_MUTATION"}]}' --expect 500 --check exception contains 'Only user messages' --save F06.send-non-user-role-empty-mutation/rejected
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$MUT_ROLE/events/search" --save F06.send-non-user-role-empty-mutation/events
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$MUT_ROLE/events/count" --check . eq 0 --save F06.send-non-user-role-empty-mutation/after  # bug

OBS_ID=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$LIVE/events/search" --query kind=openhands.sdk.event.llm_convertible.observation.ObservationEvent --check items len-ge 1 --field items.0.id)
OBS_T=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$LIVE/events/$OBS_ID" --check id eq "$OBS_ID" --field timestamp)
FROM_OBS=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$LIVE/events/search" --field items | jq -e --arg id "$OBS_ID" '[.[].id] | length - index($id)')
test "$FROM_OBS" -ge 2
control-agent-server ws listen "/sockets/events/$LIVE" --query resend_mode=since --query after_timestamp="$OBS_T" --duration 3 --save F06.search-timestamp-replay/socket | jq -e --argjson n "$FROM_OBS" '.frames - 1 >= $n'  # bug
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$LIVE/events/search" --expect 200 --save F06.search-timestamp-order-sorted/all --field items | jq -e '[.[].timestamp] | . == sort'  # bug
